name: Disharmony

source.title: Pathfinder rules text (Foundry PF2E trait descriptions)

text: Actions with the disharmony trait change your current stellar attunement to being unattuned. When you take such an action with this trait, you benefit from the additional effect of your current attunement if the action had the attuned trait, but once you complete the action, you become unattuned.
